bio: Change is constant at The Establishment, set in a historic building on Broad Street. It's all about sustainably sourced seafood here, and while some dishes like gnudi with creamy sauce and lump crab (a must-order) are mainstays, most are shifting often to include the freshest fish available. Though the kitchen is dedicated to sourcing, the cooking is far from pretentious. Case in point? Pan-seared halibut served with an aji amarillo sauce. Seared to a perfect golden-brown and sided by a fresh summer vegetable salad, it's a simple, unfussy dish that delivers. Don't skip dessert, especially their take on a blackberry cobbler....
